name: pi-harness-lite
description: Personal TUI customization plugin for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Changes Codex startup chrome, theme, diffs, status line, and history search.
interface.longDescription: Pi Harness Lite demonstrates Codex TUI plugin hooks with a quiet startup, Ghostty theme sync, a focused last-changed-file diff view, a minimal footer, a status line focused on model, git branch, and current directory, and a Ctrl+R fzf-backed project history search.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Pi Harness Lite to customize the Codex TUI status line.
